hints.title: Digit Grouping
hints.text: For each number in the array, find its maximum digit.

hints.title: Group Top Two
hints.text: Numbers can only form a pair if they share the exact same maximum digit. Group numbers by this digit from 0 to 9.

hints.title: Pair Sum Evaluation
hints.text: For each group containing at least two numbers, sum the two largest values. Return the maximum sum found, or minus one if no group has size two.

hints.title: Implementation

variables: n: number of integers in nums
complexity.notes: Extract maximum digit per integer and group into buckets 0 through 9.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: O(n^2) nested pair iteration is unnecessary when bucket grouping achieves linear time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) bucket storage allows single-pass selection of top two elements.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use digit buckets 0..9 and track only the top two values per bucket.
